profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Blizzard Entertainment | MS in Physics

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Contributed to core development of a set of .NET applications which include a Silverlight based client backed with a MS SQL Server database. This included major reworkings of code to bring them in line with task-based asynchronous operations, performance enhancement, memory leak analysis and resolution, developing a prototype Quick Search feature to quickly open data items, writing stored procedures, reworking caches and other aspects of the app to resolve concurrency issues, defect resolution and generally implementing core features.

Also contributed to many aspects of a Web API to interface with the business layer of our application using ASP.NET WebAPI, including command infrastructure, CRUD, as well as aiding in design discussion and planning. 

Also helped develop as a service which also worked with the business layer to process tasks in the background.

Involved in developing internal tools to aid in the development process, including a graphical tool to test our web API quickly in a variety of login configurations for a wide array of data, as well as automate test plans to run large batches of requests.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Ran discussion sections for Modern Physics for engineers, fielding student concerns and providing assistance with assigned work.
Taught Mechanics Lecture and Labs for Biology Majors. Duties included running discussion sections, assessing student class and lab work, administering lab sessions and administering exams.
Taught Electricity and Magnetism for Engineers. Duties included running group Tutorial sessions, assessment of student performance and administering exams.
Performed grading duties for graduate Mathematical Methods class and Numerical Methods class for graduate students, and provided assistance to students on classwork.
Gave a lecture for the Physics 3 series while substituting for the professor.

Sherwood Test Prep                                                                                                         2011  Part-Time 
GRE/SAT Prep Instructor
Taught GRE and SAT level vocabulary and mathematics reviews, as well as test-taking methodologies including test psychology, methods of approaching questions, test design, and study habits. Also assessed student performance across the 6-week program to personalize teaching styles.

positions.title: Site Representative
positions.description:
Ensured the smooth operation of an atrial fibrillation training session for sales representatives, including catering, logistics, tech support, as well as keeping presentations timely. 
Administered post-course exams.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Attended meetings, researched, and collaborated with other students to study SUSY model sparticle collision reconstruction techniques, programming and employing likelihood analyses applied to Monte Carlo data of theoretical SUSY events.

company.name: University of California, Irvine ATLAS group

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Collaborated with a team of students and scientists to prepare and ship a balloon-borne detector (CREAM) over Antarctica. 
Tested various hardware components of the balloon-borne probe, including the calorimeter construction, as well as the detector hardware. 
Performed hardware assembly and maintenance, including resurfacing, part replacement, part reconstruction, and reassembly. 
Calibrated CREAM detector at proton-proton beamline at the CERN accelerator lab in France.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Studied the correlation function of photons emitted from a pulsed diode laser at threshold voltage.
Constructed various laser setups to test physical phenomena.  
Tested the resonance properties of radio cavities.
